title: Japan reacts to wave of cyberattacks: Several important companies recently reported attacks; Digital Minister addresses threat
content_md:
Japan reacts to wave of cyberattacks: Several important companies in Japan have recently reported cyberattacks. Japan's Digital Minister spoke about the growing threat.

via Mastodon https://www.heise.de/en/news/Japan-reacts-to-wave-of-cyberattacks-11483337.html
